basic_details.job_title: Rajasthan High Court Junior Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior accountant: Graduate employees serving as Junior Judicial Assistants with 5 years of service as Junior Judicial Assistants in the establishment of the High Court of Rajasthan, as per the provisions of Rajasthan High Court Staff Service Rules, 2002.

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention additional allowances or in-hand salary figures.

selection_process: Paper-I (1) Rajasthan Service Rules, 1951 (Chapter Nos. II, III, IV, X, XI, XIII, XIV, XV & XVI)(2) Rajasthan Civil Services (Joining Time) Rules, 1981.(3) Rajasthan Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1996.(4) Rajasthan Travelling Allowance Rules. Not specified 50 3 hrs

Paper-II (1) General Financial and Accounts Rules (Chapter Nos. I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, XIV & XVIII)(2) Rajasthan Budget Manual 2012 (VII Edition): Chapter-1 Overview, Chapter-2 Definitions and General Explanations, Chapter-7 Role of Financial Advisors, Chapter-8 Role of Budget Controlling officers and Drawings and Disbursing officers (with Appendix-A, Appendix-B), Chapter-10 Budget Circular with Annexure-6, Chapter-11 Estimates of Revenue and Receipts, Chapter-13 Estimates of Expenditure, Chapter-22 Revised Estimates, Chapter-26 Review of Revenue and Receipts. Not specified 50 3 hrs
The recruitment process shall be conducted in two stages: written examination followed by a personal interview.
The Written exam shall consist of two papers
each of 50 marks and 3 hrs duration. The minimum passing marks for each paper shall be 20 marks.
The interview shall be of 25 marks. The number of successful candidates to be admitted to the interview shall be
three times the total number of vacancies.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Court at www.hcraj.nic.in.
Navigate to the recruitment section for the Junior Accountant examination.
Read the official notification and instructions carefully before filling out the online application form.
Complete the application form online within the specified time limit between 01:00 pm on 07.10.2026 and 05:00 pm on 14.10.2026.
Submit the application form online and keep a printout for future reference.
important_instructions: The merit of the candidates securing equal aggregate marks in the Written Test and Interview shall firstly be determined on the basis of higher marks obtained in the Written Test. In case candidates secure equal marks in the Written Test also, the merit shall be determined on the basis of seniority in the original cadre. Applicants are advised to keep visiting the official website regularly for updates regarding the schedule to fill the online application form.
